extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: fantasy mushroom house, main tower 5.3 m tall with a 5.1 m wide cap, small side tower 3.5 m, footprint approx. 6.0 x 6.5 m
extras.notes: exterior only; front faces -Y; two grown-together fly agaric towers with coral caps, white spots, gills and a hanging ring skirt, cream stems as walls, stone base, stone portal with arched plank door, round windows with warm glowing panes ('fantasy-mushroom-house_window_glow', emissive, not baked) and a wall lantern; movable: 'fantasy-mushroom-house_front_door' (pivot on the hinge axis at its left edge, opens by rotating about Z); no text, no symbols

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
